FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
For a highway breakdown, make the stopped vehicle visible to other drivers. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A01
If available, use a phone or two-way radio to tell authorities about your own or another vehicle’s breakdown. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A01
Roadside emergency signs may provide a telephone number or CB channel for assistance. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A01
When vehicle trouble forces a stop, leave the road and move away from traffic if possible. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A01
Activate emergency flashers to indicate vehicle trouble. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A01
If unable to leave the roadway, try to stop where others can see the vehicle, avoiding the far side of a hill or bend. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A01
The manual advises putting warning flares behind a disabled vehicle to give others time to change lanes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A01
Stay out of the roadway and do not change a tire from inside a traffic lane. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A01
Avoid traveling beside and slightly behind another vehicle, where its driver may not see you. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A01
Adjust forward or backward relative to another vehicle so its driver can see you more easily. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A01
While passing, minimize the time spent in the other driver’s blind spot. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A01
Avoid remaining alongside a bus or large truck because its driver has substantial blind areas. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A01
Warn other drivers before changing direction or slowing so they have time to respond. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R14 | anchor: A01
A turn signal left on after the maneuver can falsely suggest another planned turn. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-nm-l:new-mexico-motor-vehicle-division-taxati:handbook:pdf-0022]
